dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1863 by J. H. Colton."

"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1863 by J. H. Colton." Printed by Lang & Cooper. Insets: Southern part of Florida. 27 x 19 cm.-Colton's map of the United States showing the proposed railroad routes to the Pacific Ocean. 19 x 26 cm. General map. 1861 editions listed as entry nos. 6.5-6.6; 1862 editions listed as entry nos. 25.5-25.6. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:1,520,640. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 37.6 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
